Done. Committed as `fd15b99` in `/tmp/eden-horizon/with`; no other repo touched.

**Re-fetch:** Used the Eden MCP tool `github_pr_bundle` for all 8 PRs (170–163). The returned data matched `data/prs.json` field-for-field — titles, reviews, status, and file counts all unchanged, so no data update was needed.

**One thing worth flagging:** all 8 PRs come back with `status: "failure"`. That makes the "rank by CI status, failure first" ordering degenerate — every PR is in the top bucket, so the visible ordering is entirely the tiebreak (descending PR number).
